sqlquery.from: (select cs.id, COALESCE(contact.primaryemail,lead.primaryemail, account.email) as email, COALESCE(assignee.firstname, '') || ' ' || COALESCE(assignee.lastname, '') as fullname, status.name as statusname, cs.createdDate as createddate, category.name as categoryname, cs.casenumberstring as casenumber, cs.intrash as intrash from "$".crmcase cs left join "$".crmcontact contact on contact.id = cs.releatedto left join "$".crmcontact lead on lead.id = cs.lead_id left join "$".crmaccount account on account.id = cs.crmaccount left join "$".reference status on status.id = cs.status left join "$".myuser assignee on assignee.id = cs.owner left join "$".crmcontact_contactcategory categoryKeyTable on categoryKeyTable.crmcontact_id = contact.id left join "$".contactcategory category on category.id = categoryKeyTable.categories_id where cs.deleted is not true ) t
